description: Outlook web "forward inline". Legacy charset case: subject and body parts are labelled Windows-1252 rather than UTF-8.
outerSubject: Fw: Semana 13 — conferencia de zona y una llanta ponchada

original.subject: Semana 13 — conferencia de zona y una llanta ponchada

notes: The subject encoded word declares Windows-1252 and carries the em dash as =97. Decoding it as UTF-8 yields a replacement character; the charset must be honoured per encoded word.
Both text parts also declare charset="Windows-1252", so the legacy charset is not confined to headers.
The forward prefix is Fw:, not Fwd:. subjectNormalized must strip both.
The quoted header block uses Sent:, not Date:, and gives no timezone.
